item.title: More people than ever travelling to Limerick by train
item.description: MORE people than ever are travelling to and from Limerick by train. item.title: Commercial vacancy rate in Limerick higher than national average
item.description: LIMERICK had the highest commercial vacancy rate in Munster at the end of last year, according to a new report.
